LanguageData.ModDescription: Batch battlefield treatment, rescue, and capture orders. Mark multiple humanlike pawns or non-hostile animals and let responders carry out the requested stages in a safe, predictable order.
LanguageData.SAR_Command_Desc: By default, marks every applicable stage in the safe order: capture, field treatment, then rescue. Right-click to choose a single stage or configure the rescue point.
LanguageData.SAR_ClearAllOrders: Clear all Search and Rescue orders ({0})
LanguageData.SAR_Treat_Desc: Monitor humanlike pawns and non-hostile animals for battlefield care. Life-threatening injuries are stabilized first, then remaining wounds use a lower lane within Field Rescue. The Work tab controls Field Rescue versus Doctor ordering; Field Rescue wins when their configured priorities match. When paired with rescue, monitoring continues until safe delivery and can interrupt transport if the casualty deteriorates. Repairable colony mechs receive native repairs from mechanitors with Field Rescue and Smithing enabled, following the auto-repair toggle.
LanguageData.SAR_Rescue_Desc: Mark downed humanlike pawns and non-hostile animals for evacuation after earlier marked stages finish. Uses a suitable bed, including animal beds, or the rescue point set from this tool's right-click menu. Downed colony mechs are delivered to the rescue point.
LanguageData.SAR_Capture_Desc: Mark downed hostile humanlike pawns to be captured in place before treatment or evacuation.
LanguageData.SAR_RescuePoint_Desc: Choose a fallback safe cell. Rescuers carry marked pawns here only when no suitable bed is available.
LanguageData.SAR_OnlyHumanlike: Only living, spawned humanlike flesh pawns can be marked.
LanguageData.SAR_OnlyHumanlikeOrAnimal: Select a living humanlike, non-hostile animal, or repairable colony mech on this map.
LanguageData.SAR_HostileAnimalUnsupported: Select a humanlike pawn or a non-hostile animal for battlefield treatment and rescue.
LanguageData.SAR_NoTreatmentNeeded: This pawn has no injury that currently needs treatment.
LanguageData.SAR_TreatmentRequiresCapture: Hostile pawns must be marked for capture before they can be marked for field treatment.
LanguageData.SAR_RescueRequiresCapture: Hostile pawns must be marked for capture before they can be marked for rescue.
LanguageData.SAR_AlreadyInSafeBed: This pawn is already settled in a suitable bed.
LanguageData.SAR_CaptureRequiresHostile: Only downed hostile pawns that are not already prisoners can be captured here.
LanguageData.SAR_InvalidRescuePoint: The rescue point must be a standable, unfogged cell.
LanguageData.SAR_CE_NoMedicine: Field treatment skipped for {0}: Combat Extended stabilization requires medicine.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_RescueWorkMode_Desc: Hauling uses Hauling work. Nursing preferred prioritizes Nurse Job workers, with haulers filling in. Nursing only uses Nursing work. Enable the work type required by your chosen mode for each responder.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_MedicalCoordinationMode_Des: Marked only schedules patients with player designations. Automatic emergencies also coordinates stabilization, transfusions, infection tending and first aid for colony members. All tending extends coordination to every condition currently needing tending.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_NurseDetected: Nurse Job detected. Nursing rescue modes are available.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_NurseNotDetected: Enable Nurse Job to use nursing rescue modes. Hauling is available with the current mod setup.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_FieldRescueWorkType_Desc: Enable Field Rescue in the Work tab and set its overall rescue priority. Also enable Doctor, Warden, Hauling or Nursing work so responders can perform the corresponding tasks.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_PreemptRoutine: Interrupt cleaning and patient feeding for emergencies
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_PreemptRoutine_Desc: Allows capture and emergency treatment to take over from automatic cleaning or patient-feeding jobs. Player-ordered jobs retain priority.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_EnableStandby: Let rescuers approach patients who are being treated
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_EnableStandby_Desc: When a doctor is actually on the way or treating, a rescuer may travel toward the patient so evacuation can begin promptly.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_StandbyLead_Desc: How much earlier a rescuer may arrive than the estimated treatment end. At zero, rescuers depart when their expected travel time equals or exceeds the remaining treatment time.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_MarkerMemory_Desc: After an order completes automatically, remember it for this many game hours. If the pawn recovers and is downed again during that time, applicable markers return. Zero disables this behavior.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_BleedingSensitivity_Desc: Adjusts how triage responds to bleeding. Higher values bring smaller untreated bleeds into emergency care and continue stabilization longer.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_BloodLossWarning_Desc: A patient predicted to die from blood loss within this many game hours is admitted to emergency stabilization.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_SurgeryPriority_Desc: Raises evacuation priority for patients with life-threatening conditions requiring surgery, helping them reach a bed for treatment. Set to zero to disable this bonus.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_TreatmentTransportPriority_: Favors stabilizing patients before ordinary evacuation. Capture takes priority in the stage sequence.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_SwitchReluctance_Desc: Higher values require a larger benefit before a doctor switches patients at a safe treatment boundary, reducing walking and target churn.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_MedicineDetour_Desc: Higher values make doctors and suppliers more willing to detour for useful medicine or equipment. Urgency, scarcity, and treatment benefit still apply.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_KitPatients: Patients covered by one mission kit
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_KitPatients_Desc: Maximum number of current casualties considered when a doctor plans a multi-patient field kit.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_KitConsumables_Desc: Maximum units of each consumable carried for a mission. Each reusable device is carried as a single unit.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_FieldSupplyRadius_Desc: Supplies within this many cells of a patient can satisfy that patient's budget and remain protected while referenced.
LanguageData.SAR_Settings_Compatibility_Desc: Enabled mods appear first. Hover a row for support details. Integration adds rescue actions, responders or supply sources. Compatible covers settings, job recognition and coordinated behavior. Not enabled indicates a mod that is switched off or awaiting installation.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_CombatExtended: Uses CE stabilization, quantity-aware medicine reservations, carried-inventory access, and CE capacity limits.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_MoreInjuries: Coordinates CPR, airway care, defibrillation, hemostasis, tourniquets, saline and blood bags. Surgical-only trauma raises evacuation priority.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_MSE2: Includes dangerous conditions in triage and prioritizes evacuation for bedside emergencies. MSE2 provides its specialized surgical care, prosthetic subparts and equipment through its bedside system.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_EPOE: Works through standard health and surgery interfaces. Implants, replacements, amputations and elective operations use EPOE and vanilla surgery bills.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_SmartMedicine: Uses its medicine selection and temporary tending spots, and protects assigned field supplies. SAR restocking and delivery make medicine carried by other pawns available to CE stabilization.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_Pharmacist: Reads its severity- and pawn-category medicine recommendation while retaining the pawn's vanilla medicine ceiling as a hard limit.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_ChooseMedicine: Reads its medicine groups, injury-stage policy, ordering, and per-wound coverage for budgets, kits, deliveries, and final tending.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_MedicalTab: Reads current individual medical-care settings on each planning pass, applying table changes to the next set of assignments.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_Defaults: Population defaults ultimately use standard pawn medical-care settings, which Search and Rescue reads directly.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_EmergencyTransfusions: Creates the mod's native one-pack transfusion job and can source hemogen from the patient, responder, map, or supported carriers.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_HemogenDirect: Provides emergency hemogen transfusion when Emergency Transfusions is unavailable, using the mod's native job.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_DeathRattle: Includes life-threatening health conditions in triage. Resuscitation uses Death Rattle’s own care flow.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_RH2FirstAid: Uses RH2's native field-aid job when Combat Extended is not active and registers it as external patient ownership.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_RH2Arrest: Uses RH2's native arrest-in-place job for the capture stage.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_DubsRimkit: Recognizes self-tending and tending-others jobs, preserving player-ordered care as the priority.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_TraumaTeam: Recognizes team ownership before its first job, its treatment/transport jobs, and releases stale ownership when no operational responder remains.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_MovePatient: Asks the patient's transfer component for its preferred medical bed before falling back to vanilla bed search.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_MedPod: Recognizes pod delivery, rescue, self-entry and facility occupancy to coordinate with MedPod’s admission and treatment flow.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_Casevac: CASEVAC rescue and capture transport jobs are registered as external ownership; its manual commands remain authoritative.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_SmarterCapture: Its automatic capture WorkGiver participates in the common ownership gate; player-forced capture remains authoritative.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_PickUpAndHaul: Keeps supplies assigned to patients and current medical plans available for battlefield care.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_Hospitality: Coordinates rescue through standard beds, guest status and faction relations. Hospitality settings and systems provide reception, fees and visitor activities.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_VehicleFramework: Stationary, reachable player vehicles provide cargo for medical kits and deliveries. Use the vehicle and related mods’ actions for patient boarding and in-vehicle care.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_NurseJob: Offers hauling, nurse-preferred, and nurse-only rescue modes. Supportive interventions use Nursing with doctors as fallback where appropriate.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_WorkTab: Reads individual WorkGiver priorities when assigning the corresponding rescue tasks.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_MechWorkTab: Reads colony-mech detailed work settings when deciding which battlefield lanes a mech may enter.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_WVCWorkModes: Honors additional mech work modes and their effective work authority.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_SearchDestroy: Search and Destroy provides drafted combat control. After undrafting, pawns can join Search and Rescue according to their work settings.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_CommonSense: After tending, automatic cleaning yields to further rescue work. Player-ordered queues retain their existing orders.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_PriorityTreatment: Recognizes field treatment, supply, CE, More Injuries and RH2 jobs so responders stay marked as busy during their tasks.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_TreatDyingFirst: Ordinary tending uses its urgency ordering. SAR coordinates admitted patients through unified matching. Player-ordered jobs have priority.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_StabilizeBleeding: Player-ordered bleeding control has priority. Combining it with SAR designations is partially compatible, with job behavior awaiting runtime validation.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_AlliesHelpful: Unforced ally treatment and rescue jobs yield for SAR-marked patients; the mod keeps its normal behavior for every unmarked patient.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_NoOneLeftBehind: Enemy evacuation remains authoritative once a hostile carrier starts it. A capture-marked enemy may therefore escape before a responder can claim them.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_StayInBed: Field treatment, supply and transport can take over from its idle bed-rest job.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_GrievousWounds: Overflow damage produces ordinary injuries, which are included automatically in bleeding, severity, and treatment scoring.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_VFEMedical: Added medical beds and medicine follow vanilla definitions and are discovered automatically.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_SensibleBedOwnership: Checks medical-bed suitability and current bed ownership before each transfer to select an appropriate destination.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_YokaiVillage: Non-hostile flesh animals can receive tending and rescue with standard medicine and animal beds. Capture applies to humanlike targets.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_Hardworking: Reads Hardworking settings and respects stop, follow, schedule and rest permissions. Use deterministic work modes for SAR automatic dispatch; species-specific job execution awaits runtime testing.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_Paniel: Paniel keeps its native medicine selection and tending. Biological emergency procedures are excluded. Full repair uses PN_Repair and its repair kit at a bed; race-level playtesting is pending.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_Androids: Mechanical droids use native repair-parts selection and TendPatient; ChjAndroid keeps ordinary medicine. Biological emergency procedures are excluded. Full repair uses the native surgery flow; race-level playtesting is pending.
LanguageData.SAR_Compatibility_AndroidsExpanded: Uses Androids pawn and repair interfaces. Expanded races and special abilities are awaiting in-game testing.
